title: W11746350 — Service Diagnostic mode entry
description: Settings-based Service Diagnostics entry (Option A or B).

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body:
Option A: Settings → Info → Service & Support → code 111 111 111 (digit 1 nine times) → CONFIRM → Service Diagnostics home.
Option B: Settings → Diagnostics home → Service Diagnostics Code → repeat any 3-digit sequence 3× (e.g. 123123123) → OK.
Use Component Activation for load tests (Bake, Door Latch Motor, etc.).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Diagnostics mode by pressing Settings > Info > Service & Support.
